steps.content: [Footsteps, Witch's portrait]
In an instant, everything falls silent. The dripping water and the sound of the wind have all vanished. The entire world seems to contain nothing but the unhurried footsteps of the approaching Witch.

The shadow that has been haunting you finally reveals its true form. She embodies every fairy tale's dark witch—flowing, gradient grayish purple hair like seaweed, a dress as dark as night, pitch-black eyes flecked with gold, and a face full of cunning.
She extends her hand languidly. Dangling from her fingertips is the familiar golden hourglass you've seen each time you've died.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: My dear guest, you've damaged the theater setup and repeatedly vandalized the props, ruining the experience for other guests... I have no choice but to isolate you for the time being.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Just calm down. If you have any concerns, please discuss them with our staff, all right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Finally. It's taken long enough for the lead actress of this play to come onstage. Tell me your name, Sinner.
Throughout your encounter, you've developed nothing but distaste for her. The Witch covers her mouth as she chuckles, then performs an elegant curtsy.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: You may call me <color=#fb9259>Irrheia</color>, the weaver and keeper of this little world.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Of course, you may also address me by my role in this story: the Witch of Rewind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're clearly in an illusion, yet I don't feel a trace of Mania. Sorry, but MBCC cannot allow a Sinner as powerful as you to remain at large.
The Witch blinks.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: In a story, one must follow its rules. Some things simply cannot be mentioned here.
But you're speaking of facts, not stories. Is she stalling for time? Or trying to shirk her responsibility? Either way, you're not falling for it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The game should have been long over. Stop trying to distract me with your excuses.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've created an illusion so realistic yet independent from the rules of reality... You're no ordinary Sinner. What's the true purpose behind this "looping story"?
The Witch chuckles, running her fingertips softly in the air, as if plucking at invisible strings. Her tone is gentle, yet meaningful.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Oh, that's a little exaggerated, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: I've never coerced anyone. I merely answered the deepest desires in their hearts. As long as everyone enjoys themselves, that's what matters, right? As for how it all works... is it really necessary to get into every trivial detail?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You indulge and twist their desires. I have reason to suspect you're provoking the darkest parts of people's minds on purpose, turning them into your puppets to feed Mania.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: "Puppets"? "Feed"? What imaginative vocabulary. Your life is clearly far more fascinating than any script I've written.

She handles your questioning effortlessly, completely dismissing your accusations. Somehow, she's even made it seem like you're the one being needlessly critical, ruining everyone's fictional adventure.
You step forward, crimson shackle energy pulsing around your body, making an invisible but palpable threat. Only then does the Witch's mocking smile fade as she spreads her hands in surrender.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: With power like that, no wonder you don't get along with the others. It's really not fair to the other guests, is it?

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Sigh... I bet even I can't withstand the power of those "shackles" of yours. You must have encountered many highly destructive Sinners to be so sensitive to Mania.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: But... I'm really just an ordinary employee who wants to keep my job here. What would it take for you to spare me, spare this story, and everyone in it?
She lowers her head and casts her eyes downward, her voice softening a little pleadingly.
[Switch back to Prima's portrait, her feigned innocent and pitiful expression floating around like a Ghost]

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Mr. Voyager, don't you remember how kind you were to me when we first met? We explored the world together and went on such thrilling adventures!
steps.female_content: Miss Voyager, don't you remember how kind you were to me when we first met? We explored the world together and went on such thrilling adventures!

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Because you're just a very kind person, aren't you?
[Release the shackles in frustrated rage]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't bother testing me with that face.
[Switch back to Witch's portrait]

After using the shackles multiple times, your body is starting to give out. Such a feeble attack isn't enough to defeat the Witch, only forcing her to put her real face back on. The Witch steps back with momentary surprise, then a smile blooms on her face.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Are you angry? I thought you'd prefer Prima's innocent and bubbly persona... It's refreshing, compared to that of someone who has been worn down by life, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't mind discussing my likes and dislikes with you after we end this farce. But I'll pick the location. How about the interrogation room at the MBCC?
[Insert special item - Notebook]

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: I've never quite found the right role for you, until now... I finally know what you are.
The Witch's lips curl into a smile as the notebook she was holding begins to float in midair.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: The Sinner captor... <color=#fb9259>Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, ${PlayerName}</color>. Or perhaps...
[Insert Chief's ID badge - "Anomaly"]
With a flourish, a crooked name tag appears in her hand. It's the very one you threw away.
The metal plate unfolds before you. The word "Voyager" has been erased, and a new word slowly brands itself onto the surface: <color=#fb9259>Anomaly</color>. The mission on the back also changes.
The hero who shreds the evil script and defends reality...?
You're unperturbed by this blatant mockery, simply focusing on the new skill that has appeared below the mission text.
Skill: Anomaly Description: Unknowable, invisible, and uncontrollable. Everything is variable.

options: A skill is a skill. It may come in handy.
A skill from the Witch? No thanks.

steps.content: If it were any other skill, you would certainly refuse it. But since it says "uncontrollable," you reach out, grab the name tag, and tuck it into your shirt pocket.
Just as you're about to withdraw your hand, the name tag darts automatically into your sleeve and slides along your clothes until it reaches your chest, where it firmly attaches itself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You...!
The Witch continues to smile sweetly, seemingly very satisfied with the role she has assigned to you.
She appreciates unpredictability and is even looking forward to what comes next.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've had a terrible experience here so far. Once this is over, I will be filing a formal complaint with the Consumer Protection Bureau.

Seeing your serious expression, the Witch's smile fades as she taps her cheek twice with her fingertip. With a casual wave of her hand, the golden hourglass constrained by you begins turning again, your power falters, and you stumble backward.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Sigh, I see... You must make a scene, mustn't you? Very well then.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Let's continue your story and see, in the end, which one of us will catch the other.
[Insert effect: Hourglass reversing and shattering]
[Insert CG - You're Awake - Duo]

Like a butterfly flapping its wings, the script turns to a new page as a pen scribbles on it. The story is being rearranged, and words are reorganizing themselves on the paper. The entire world's rules are transforming with each small stroke.
In a small grid, in the dim hot spring inn, in the sky directly above Eastside, the Witch waves her fingers, and these words can change the world just like that.
[CG: Three quick flashes of the Sacrifice scene]
The scene before your eyes shifts continuously, as you're swept away by a torrent of words in between pages, unable to open your eyes.

Every scene you've witnessed here rewinds in your mind, the horrifying images replaying constantly. In this cycle, who is the offering trapped in an endless sacrificial ritual, Prima or the Witch? Or perhaps they have always been the same person.

Mania spreads as people transform into Mania-corrupted monsters. Space tears apart and reconstructs itself. Countless fractured scenes are pieced together. You can no longer distinguish whether you're in reality or inside the script.

Boom. Finally, Mania sweeps away the fragile cardboard scenery and spreads across the sky of Eastside. With a violent tremor, your surroundings suddenly open up. Beyond the walls lie none other than the familiar streets of Eastside!
[Screen shakes several times] Scene transition to Eastside streets

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: W-What's happening?! Am I seeing things? I feel a little... dizzy? I just got these new glasses.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: What the ****? There's a huge crack in the building? An earthquake? Hey everyone, I'm live right here to broadcast the situation in real time! Don't switch channels!

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Wait, can you see that? What is that in the sky?!
[Insert effect: Hourglass flowing sand + Mania]
A golden hourglass appears in the sky above the city, slowly emitting intertwined streams of gold and black light.
[Scene Change] Hot Spring Inn Entrance + Special Effects

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: The sky... is ripping apart.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Please don't destroy Rumina's home...
